transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I have an overwhelming, intense fear of dogs. It has gotten to the point where it is starting to really affect my daily life, so I decided I need to seek some help for it.

latest_inference.note: Based on the interview, the presentation is a circumscribed, intense fear of dogs that is causing functional impairment. This most strongly fits Specific Phobia. No prior candidates were provided, so there is no comparison to make or narrowing from a previous differential.
